regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrow, resource-led leadership: Gold Miners top the ranks on trend strength but are unscorable, while eligible breadth has narrowed to 8/22 themes and rotation is not directional. The validated absolute-trend gate did NOT help on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so the detector's edge here is drawdown-control only in markets where it holds — treat all leans as low-conviction judgement, not extracted alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the resource leadership broadens from Gold Miners into Industrial Metals via sustained eligibility. The observable condition that would retire this watch: Industrial Metals (512400.SS) posts two consecutive weeks of positive excess return over CSI 300 while its breadth stays above 0.7 — a confirmed handoff, not a predicted one.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: The only scorable theme in the top tier with trend-eligible leadership and non-crowded positioning. Rank #2, durability_bar 0.72, and breadth 0.846 suggest the resource narrative extends beyond gold into base metals. I lean with the prevailing trend-eligible flow rather than against it, but conviction stays low because the trend gate failed on this market and the theme ranks carry no forward edge.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag and a mean-reverting market history mean the resource move could reverse sharply; if the gold-led narrative stalls, industrial metals lack a standalone catalyst and the breadth could compress quickly.

falsifier.text: 515230.SS lags CSI 300 by 3% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Eligible and mid-table on rank, but the ONLY crowded theme in the eligible set (crowding_z 1.15, crowded true) with mediocre durability (0.52) and low cohesion (breadth 0.357). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade — but as a relative lean within trend discipline, underweight versus the broader eligible set reflects the extended positioning without predicting a reversal.
evidence: crowding_z 1.15, crowded true — most extended eligible theme
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO could be absorbing flow from the narrowing resource narrative as a defensive rotation; crowding flags sometimes precede further inflows in reflexive A-share sectors, and underweighting an eligible trend could mean missing continuation.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Trend-tagged (hurst_tag trend) and eligible with zero crowding, but breadth 0.0 signals a single-stock-led move with no internal confirmation. It sits below AI Compute on rank but carries a cleaner trend signature. Lean is positive only relative to the weak eligible field, fully aware the trend gate has no validated edge here.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth means the trend is one stock; a single adverse earnings print or US export-control headline could reverse it without any sector-wide support, and the mean-reverting A-share tape punishes trend-following entries.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS lags CSI 300 by 4% before the check-by date
